description: Brand-neutral design tokens (DTCG JSON, three layers plus dimensions) and a typed theme contract with light and dark themes.

SCOPE.description: npm scope WITHOUT the leading @, for package names (@ds-scope/tokens, @ds-scope/theme). The literal is a valid package name on purpose: pnpm rejects '<SCOPE>' as a dependency name, so the module installs and tests unassembled. Assembly replaces every occurrence of the literal in file contents and paths.

notes: Root files (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.base.json, .npmrc) are a minimal standalone workspace; the monorepo-root module owns the real ones and these must be merged into them, not copied over.
